name: revealwhy
description: Set up a website, test it with test visitors, read the results, send problems to GitHub or Notion as tickets, and get a report. Works from Claude Code through MCP.

api_key.title: RevealWhy API key
api_key.description: Scoped key (starts with rw_). RevealWhy → Settings → Developers → Secret API keys. Give it the scopes for what you want Claude to do; the README lists the scope each tool needs. Leave empty to start free from the conversation.

project_id.title: RevealWhy project ID
project_id.description: Default project for every tool (RevealWhy → Settings → Tracking code → Project ID). Tools can still take projectId explicitly.
